g.text: What people can do in SkillSwap | Current backend support
Create an account, sign in and manage access
Submit student proof and view student status
Approve, reject or revoke student status
Submit skill evidence and view decision history
Review matching skill evidence and give a decision
Publish and manage an online class
Try a simulated top-up, view wallet balance and history
Review the operations dashboard and audit log
Lock or release an account, with a reason
Admin-initiated only (C-010): nothing locks an account automatically.
Web and mobile both book through the real API.
Verifier and Administrator accounts are assigned by operators.
Teacher withdrawals are not available yet.
The same student account can learn and teach.
Chat, ratings and push notifications are not implemented here.
